nodes.title: 24. CUSTOMER GRIEVANCE REDRESSAL PROCEDURE:
nodes.summary: The text outlines the customer grievance redressal procedure for TATA AIG General Insurance, including contact methods (24x7 toll-free number and email), escalation levels with response timelines (Level 1: 8 days, Level 2: 7 days, Nodal Officer: 10 days), and the option to approach the Insurance Ombudsman if unresolved within 30 days.
